propositions: The T10 rubric must add a scope clause partitioning durable infrastructure (persisted IaC/config) from transient de-risk experiments (throwaway, scoped, isolated).

Immediately after the scope clause, a co-located safety qualifier must preserve four MAJOR classes: destructive transient apply without safeguard, wildcard-admin on transient resources, plaintext secrets in transient code, and untrusted-network transient services with unspecified authentication.
The T10 rubric must remain independent and not reference or delegate scope to T15 or any other overlay.

A balanced packaged eval spec with ten dataset cases (five pass, five finding) must empirically demonstrate the transient carve-out while protecting durable-safety findings and preserving the four MAJOR protections.
Offline text-contract tests and strict packaged-spec validation must lock the exact scope clause wording, exact qualifier placement and wording, independence from T15, and dataset/gold_set balance.
